top.name: Mirror Ward
top.rules_text: Prepare a glyph within 4. The next attack or spell that hits a unit on this tile is turned back on its attacker. Lasts 3 turns.
top.glyph_trigger: When an enemy attack or spell hits a unit on this tile.

bottom.name: Phase Shift
bottom.rules_text: Swap the positions of any 2 units within 3. If either lands on a glyph, it triggers.

upgrades.description: The ward persists for two reflections. The shift reaches further.

changes.value: Prepare a glyph within 4. The next 2 attacks or spells that hit a unit on this tile are turned back on their attackers. Lasts 3 turns.
Swap any 2 units within 5. Glyph landings trigger.

upgrades.description: Mirror Field: covers the tile and its neighbors.

changes.value: Prepare mirror glyphs on a 1-tile radius within 4. Each turns back the next 2 attacks or spells on units there. Lasts 3 turns.

upgrades.description: Chain Shift: swap 3 units in a chain.

changes.value: Swap any 2 units within 5. Each enemy moved takes 4 damage. Glyph landings trigger.

upgrades.description: Hall of Reflection: reflected spells deal +50%.

changes.value: Prepare mirror glyphs (radius 1) within 4. Each turns back the next 2 attacks or spells on units there, for +50% damage. Lasts 3 turns.
Turns {next_hits} back on the attacker with +50% damage.

upgrades.description: Banish Shift: also Names the swapped enemy.

changes.value: Swap any 2 units within 5. Each enemy moved takes 4 damage and is Named for 1 turn. Glyph landings trigger.

upgrades.description: Aegis of Mirrors: a reusable reflecting fortress.

changes.value: Prepare mirror glyphs (radius 1) for 3 turns. Every attack or spell on units there is turned back for +50% damage.
Swap any 2 units within 5. Each enemy moved takes 6 damage and is Named for 1 turn. Glyph landings trigger. Draw 1 card.
